new_value: FIXED on beads-worker-4 (landed via janitor syncs eb2429a7ef + 3e5e094a5d): failed capability re-announces now retry with a hard bound — _retry_capability_announcement runs attempts 2..CAPABILITY_ANNOUNCE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3 with jittered delay random.uniform(2.5,5.0)s (jitter desynchronizes mesh-wide retries and defeats jamming-predictable fixed windows, same rationale as scheduled_send). Round-2/3 review fixes folded in: retry aborts if dodag.dodag_id != new_root before each attempt (stale-root disclosure, v89j); one-pending supersede (cancel+sync-discard prior retries); _cleanup_started cancels retry tasks AFTER the receive-task cancel and the receive gather itself is wrapped in try/except BaseException so a cancelled cleanup cannot skip it. 6 new tests: recovery-after-loss (seq 2 delivered), abandon-after-3 (independent oracle calls==3), cleanup-cancels-pending (real 5s delay, suite <0.4s proves cancel), stale-root abort, supersede, jitter pinning (midpoint 3.75). 16/16 + node suite pass under -W error::RuntimeWarning; ruff/mypy clean. 3x codereview across 3 convergence rounds (kimi): final round correctness PASS, security PASS, robustness PASS. One finding filed: wzsf P3 (fragment-session leak window when a retry fires mid-cleanup).
